item.title: West Ham advance in FA Cup; Mansfield cause upset
item.description: West Ham have avoided an upset in the FA Cup fourth round with a 1-nil extra-time win at League 1 Burton. They held on with 10-men after Freddie Potts was sent-off. There's been a big shock in the FA Cup wuth League One Mansfield winning 2-1 at Premier League strugglers Burnley. Advertisement Southampton have beaten Leicester 2-1 after extra-time to make the 5th round. Manchester City eased past League Two Salford 2-nil and Norwich were 3-1 winners over West Brom.

item.title: Ireland beat Italy
item.description: Ireland have survived a scare to beat Italy 20-13 in rugby union's Six Nations. They trailed 10-5 at half-time in Dublin - and could have fallen further behind - but the Italians had a try ruled out for a forward pass. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry and Galway draw
item.description: Kerry have drawn with Galway in the Allianz Football League. It ended 2-17 to 3-14 in Austin Stack Park, Tralee Kerry's Dylan Casey had the first score after 2 minutes. Team mates Micheal Burns, in the 6th minute, and Keith Evans, after 8 minutes, extended the Kingdom advantage to 3 points to nil. Galway had their first point in the 10th minute.
